describe: The image shows a snow-covered ground surface with a mottled, crusty texture of white and pale blue-grey patches. Thin dark teal-green cracks run diagonally across the surface, with a few small darker grey-brown rock-like spots scattered through it. Lighting is bright and nearly flat with low to moderate contrast, dominated by near-white tones and soft cool blue shading. Fully opaque, no transparent areas.
